0022600211.text: The Bucks come in at 1-9 on a six-game losing streak, 15th in the East and 0-4 on the road, while the Knicks are 5-4 on a three-game winning streak and 5th in the East. Milwaukee is missing Tyler Herro (knee bruise) and Kel'el Ware (ankle sprain), and New York is missing Josh Hart (ankle), all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Bucks lost 1-2 to New York, including a 127-98 Knicks win in Milwaukee on February 27, 2026.
